opening_question: Namaste. Pet dard ke baare mein bataiye — exactly kahan dard ho raha hai?

mandatory_slots.question: Pet mein exactly kahan dard hai — upar, neeche, dayein, baayein, ya poore pet mein?
1 se 10 ke beech dard kitna tez hai?
Dard lagatar rehta hai ya aata-jaata hai?
Dard khaana khaane se pehle badhta hai ya baad mein?
Aajkal mein kuch bahar ka, baasi, ya alag khaya tha?

screening_questions.question: Loose motion ya dast ho rahe hain?

background_slots.question: Pehle kabhi gastric, ulcer, gallstone, ya pet ki koi bimari hui hai?
Koi painkiller ya dawai already li hai?
